title: Add long-form rules-pack compiler story page to eshyra.app
description: Add a durable, search-indexable long-form technical article at /rules-pack/ on the eshyra.app static site explaining why the D&D 5e SRD 5.1 rules pack exists, how the historical deterministic importer evolved into a source-grounded rules compiler with an executable-curation stage, the model/engine execution boundary, provenance/reproducibility, the three-layer (pack semantics / live state / engine services) separation, and what the downloadable pack is. Faithful to ADR 0007, ADR 0017, and docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. Extend site/build.mjs to render a second template sharing dynamic pack metadata; link it prominently from the homepage rules-pack section and back to the download. No React/CMS/bundler; preserve terminal aesthetic. Status wording must reflect current thawed-reaudit state (not frozen/final/playable).
